title: Cái Răng Floating Market
text: Located about 6 km from Ninh Kiều Wharf along the Cần Thơ River, Cái Răng is the largest wholesale floating market in the Mekong Delta. Boats gather between 05:00 and 09:00 daily, with the busiest trading between 05:30 and 07:30. Vendors hang sample produce like pineapples, watermelons, and pumpkins on tall bamboo poles (cây bẹo) so buyers can spot what each boat sells from afar. There is no entrance fee for the river itself, though visitors pay for boat transport from Ninh Kiều Pier or An Bình Market.
source: Lumen Travel Cần Thơ Field Notes (2026)

title: Phong Điền Floating Market
text: Roughly 17 km southwest of central Cần Thơ, Phong Điền Floating Market is smaller and much quieter than Cái Răng, focusing on retail trade among local residents. Small wooden sampans sell fresh fruit, garden vegetables, household goods, and hot bowls of noodle soup directly on the water. Most activity happens early, from 05:00 to 07:30, and nearly all boats leave by 08:00. Because fewer tour groups visit, it suits travelers looking for an unhurried morning river trip.
source: Lumen Travel Cần Thơ Field Notes (2026)

title: Bình Thủy Ancient House
text: Built in 1870 by the Dương family at 142/144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa Street in Bình Thủy District, this five-compartment house blends French colonial facade details with traditional southern Vietnamese wooden interiors. Visitors can walk through the courtyard orchid garden and see antique porcelain, carved altars, and period furniture used as a filming site for the movie The Lover. The house opens daily from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:00 to 18:00. Admission is 20,000 VND per person.
source: Lumen Travel Heritage Guide — Bình Thủy District

title: Ninh Kiều Wharf & Night Market
text: Ninh Kiều Wharf sits along Hai Bà Trưng Street where the Cần Thơ River meets the Hậu River and serves as the main waterfront promenade in the city center. Entry to the riverside park and the illuminated Love Pedestrian Bridge is free 24 hours a day. Every evening from around 17:30 to 23:00, the nearby Cần Thơ Night Market stalls sell grilled skewers, bánh tráng nướng, fresh fruit shakes, and handmade souvenirs. Most river cruises and floating market boats also depart from this pier.
source: Lumen Travel City Center Walk Guide

title: Ông Pagoda (Quảng Triệu Hội Quán)
text: Situated at 32 Hai Bà Trưng Street across from Ninh Kiều Park, Ông Pagoda was built in the late 19th century by the local Cantonese community and is dedicated to Quan Công. Inside, large hanging incense coils fill the main hall with smoke beneath ceramic roof dragons and carved wooden panels. The pagoda opens every day from 07:00 to 18:00 with free entry. Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is expected when stepping inside the prayer hall.
source: Lumen Travel Heritage Guide — Ninh Kiều District

title: Munirangsyaram Pagoda
text: Located at 36 Hòa Bình Boulevard in central Cần Thơ, Munirangsyaram is a Theravada Buddhist temple established in 1948 for the city's Khmer community. Its bright yellow and gold towers, three-tiered roof ornaments, and serene main sanctuary make it distinct from Vietnamese and Chinese temples in the area. Visitors may enter the courtyard and shrine daily from 06:30 to 18:00 free of charge. Quiet behavior and removing shoes before entering the main hall are required.

title: Cần Thơ Museum
text: At 1 Hòa Bình Boulevard near Ninh Kiều District, the Cần Thơ Museum displays over 5,000 artifacts covering the natural geography, Khmer and Hoa communities, and agricultural tools of the Mekong Delta. It is a convenient air-conditioned stop during midday heat or sudden rain showers. Opening hours are Tuesday to Sunday from 08:00 to 11:00 and 14:00 to 17:00; the museum is closed on Mondays. General admission is free for visitors.

title: Mỹ Khánh Tourist Village
text: Located at 335 Lộ Vòng Cung in Phong Điền District about 10 km from the center, Mỹ Khánh Tourist Village combines tropical fruit orchards with traditional southern Mekong activities. Guests can walk under rambutan, mango, and durian trees, watch pig races, feed crocodiles, or try walking across monkey bridges. The park operates daily from 07:30 to 17:30. Standard entrance tickets cost 120,000 VND for adults and 60,000 VND for children, excluding extra game or boat fees.
source: Lumen Travel Phong Điền Eco-Route Notes

title: Chín Hồng Fruit Orchard
text: Chín Hồng Fruit Orchard sits in Mỹ Nhơn Hamlet, Phong Điền District, and is a family-run garden popular for tasting fresh seasonal fruit straight from the trees. Depending on the month, visitors find mangosteen, Hạ Châu Burmese grape, star apple, and rambutan along shaded canal paths. The orchard opens daily from 07:00 to 17:00. A basic garden entry ticket is 50,000 VND per person, with picked fruit and traditional cakes charged separately.
source: Lumen Travel Phong Điền Eco-Route Notes

title: Cồn Sơn Islet Community Tourism
text: Cồn Sơn is a small alluvial islet on the Hậu River in Bình Thủy District, reached by a 5-minute wooden ferry from Cô Bắc Pier (about 20,000 VND round trip). Local households collaborate to host visitors for hands-on experiences such as watching trained flying snakehead fish jump out of ponds and baking traditional bánh kẹp or puffed rice cakes. Visits typically run from 07:30 to 17:00, and small-group tours work best when booked a day ahead. Activities are paid per household stop, averaging 30,000 to 50,000 VND each.

title: Bằng Lăng Stork Sanctuary
text: Roughly 50 km northwest of downtown Cần Thơ in Thốt Nốt District, Bằng Lăng Stork Sanctuary is a bamboo grove reserve where thousands of wild storks, herons, and egrets nest. The best viewing windows are early morning from 06:00 to 07:30 when birds fly out to forage, and late afternoon between 16:30 and 18:00 as huge flocks return at dusk. An elevated wooden observation tower lets visitors look across the treetops without disturbing the nests. The sanctuary opens 05:30 to 18:30 daily with an entry fee of 20,000 VND.
source: Lumen Travel Thốt Nốt Nature Guide

title: Cần Thơ Artificial Beach
text: Located along the Hậu River in Cái Khế Ward near the Cần Thơ Bridge, this 400-meter man-made riverside beach was built with transported fine white sand rather than muddy riverbanks. Visitors come in the late afternoon for breezy river views of the Cần Thơ Bridge, casual seaside-style drinks, and jet-ski or kayak rentals. Public access to the sandy shoreline is free from 06:00 to 21:00, though water sports and beach chairs carry separate rental charges.
source: Lumen Travel City Center Walk Guide

title: Getting to and Around Cần Thơ
text: From Ho Chi Minh City, express sleeper and seater buses (such as Phương Trang / FUTA and Thành Bưởi) run frequently from Miền Tây Bus Station and take 3.5 to 4 hours via the expressway, costing roughly 165,000 to 200,000 VND per one-way ticket. Cần Thơ International Airport (VCA) sits about 10 km from Ninh Kiều District with domestic flights to Hanoi, Da Nang, and Phu Quoc. Inside the city, app-based taxis, motorbike taxis, and bicycle or scooter rentals (around 120,000–150,000 VND per day) make getting between wards straightforward.

title: Signature Cần Thơ Dishes & Street Food
text: Must-try local specialties include crispy bánh xèo stuffed with pork, shrimp, and mung beans; bánh cống (deep-fried mung bean and shrimp cups served with fresh herbs); lẩu mắm (fermented fish hotpot packed with river vegetables); and grilled snakehead fish (cá lóc nướng trui). Early visitors at Cái Răng Floating Market can order steaming bowls of hủ tiếu or iced milk coffee served directly from vendor sampans for 30,000 to 40,000 VND. Popular evening food spots cluster around Đề Thám Street, Trần Phú Street, and the Ninh Kiều Night Market.

title: Best Time to Visit & Weather Guide
text: Cần Thơ has a tropical monsoon climate with warm temperatures between 25°C and 34°C year-round. The dry season runs from December to April and offers sunny mornings and lower humidity, making it the easiest time for walking and cycling tours. From May to August, orchards across Phong Điền hit peak tropical fruit harvest, while September to November brings the Mekong high-water season (mùa nước nổi) with lush waterways and occasional afternoon showers.

title: Boat Charter Prices & Safety Tips at Ninh Kiều Pier
text: At Ninh Kiều Wharf, licensed wooden boats leave from 05:00 onward for Cái Răng Floating Market. A shared-tour seat typically costs 100,000 to 150,000 VND per person for a 3-hour morning loop, while chartering a private boat for 2 to 6 passengers runs between 400,000 and 700,000 VND depending on whether a fruit garden or noodle workshop stop is added. Always confirm the full route and return time with the captain before boarding, wear the provided life jacket on open river stretches, and keep electronics in a waterproof pouch.
source: Lumen Travel Ninh Kiều Pier Advisory (2026)
